title: Charming 1 Bdrm Condo in Resort
description:
Just one mile from the Grand Ole Opry, this resort provides a great central location to explore all that central Tennessee has to offer.  Whether you choose to visit the Country Music Hall of Fame, the Nashville Zoo, or the Jack Daniel's Distillery, you will find adventure and Southern hospitality day and night in Music City!

The space
This is a one bedroom/one bath condo.  It has a King sized bed and a Queen sized sleeper sofa.  There is a washer/dryer and a kitchen.  
It is either a suite or a deluxe unit, based on availability when the host confirms.
This is a timeshare resort, you will NOT be required to attend a timeshare presentation or tour the property but you will have the benefits that this first class resort offers. Individual unit decor may vary slightly from photos as resorts make updates and changes.
Staying at a vacation resort property has many advantages over the traditional hotel stay.
Assigned unit may be handicap accessible.

Guest access
Amenities
2 Outdoor Swimming Pools
Organized Activities Program
Outdoor Hot Tub
Live Entertainment
Basketball
Indoor Swimming Pool
Exercise Equipment
Playground
Picnic/BBQ Area

Other things to note
Parking is free (no valet parking available).
The nearest grocery store is five miles from the resort.
A vehicle is recommended to enjoy the area.
Buildings 10 and 11 do not have elevators.
A credit card is required for the $250 security deposit requested at check in.
